mappingContract.sourceIndices: Zero-based and local to each template. Remap when splitting/merging templates or acoustically merging adjacent units.
mappingContract.intervalRule: Activate union of contributor events, never enclosing min/max hold across unrelated words or true gaps.
mappingContract.unitGranularity: Lexical/morphological editorial candidates are not selected acoustic boundaries. Group adjacent suffixes only when the recording supports one indivisible inflected word and document that rationale.
mappingContract.punctuation: Attached display punctuation has no independent source event. Japanese tokens concatenate without spaces within words.
mappingContract.readingLifetime: Separate source-word body, bounded soft carry, neutral reading hold and decorative tail. First active word frame is fully opaque.
mappingContract.referencePolicy: Keep user-reference.txt unchanged; classical sources establish text/meaning, not what is performed.

layoutContract.emphasis: Equal perceived size, weight, rest/active contrast and synchronization precision in all visible lanes. Stable color-only focus.
layoutContract.longLines: Reflow the whole lane group instead of shrinking or dimming one translation.
layoutContract.fontReview: Real Japanese coverage and visually compatible Cyrillic/Latin face; inspect baseline, glyph completeness and realistic mobile size.
layoutContract.pictureReview: Complete original picture and every intended layer visible after startup, seek and format change; audio advance alone is insufficient.
layoutContract.renderGate: Preview-only authorization; current synchronization review and render approval remain separate and unset.
